column1: # Regex subset valid in POSIX ERE (awk) and .NET: no \s \d \b, no [[:class:]], no {n,m}. Use [ ] for space.
# Applied to non-comment lines. Suppress per line with a trailing comment: lint-ignore: CODE[,CODE]

column5: bashism: builtin/keyword not in POSIX sh (source -> .)
local is not POSIX; dash, busybox and bash accept it (ShellCheck SC3043)
echo -e is not portable (dash prints -e); use printf
bashism: read options (POSIX read supports -r only)
$'...' is literal text in dash 0.5.12 and older; Termux's dash 0.5.13.5 expands it (use printf to stay portable)
bashism: brace sequence {1..N} (use seq or a loop)
pipefail missing in dash 0.5.12 and older; probe with (set -o pipefail) 2>/dev/null first
zsh: read -p reads a coprocess; use read '?prompt' var
zsh arrays are 1-indexed; element [0] is empty
zsh special parameter: a local named path shadows PATH (commands stop resolving) and status is read-only; rename the variable
hard-coded FHS path (absent in Termux): use $PREFIX/..., $TMPDIR, $HOME
literal Termux path; prefer $PREFIX or $HOME (literal expected only in shebangs)
command absent from a default Termux install: guard with command -v, install a package, or use a project wrapper
Android system shell, not Termux dash/bash
su exists in Termux as a wrapper even without root; command -v su succeeds on non-root devices, test with su -c true (exit status)
UI log prefix tokens present; allowed only in installers/general utilities, never in command wrappers or CLI integrations
